title.zh: Sing-box 桌面客户端图形界面实操：从零配置出海代理到 TUN 虚拟网卡全流量托管
title.en: Sing-box Desktop GUI Walkthrough: From Initial Configuration to System-Wide TUN Interface Capture

description.zh: 面向普通用户的 Sing-box 桌面图形化客户端保姆级实操教程。覆盖 Windows / macOS 平台主流 Sing-box GUI 工具下载、一键订阅导入、图形化分流模式选择与开启虚拟网卡透明代理。
description.en: User-friendly desktop walkthrough for Sing-box graphical interfaces across Windows and macOS. Step-by-step guidance on downloading GUI variants, importing subscriptions, and enabling full system-level TUN mode.
